operations.before:
_local_function_declaration: $ => seq(
      repeat($._attribute_list),
      repeat($.modifier),
      field('type', $.type),
      field('name', $.identifier),
      field('type_parameters', optional($.type_parameter_list)),
      field('parameters', $.parameter_list),
    ),
operations.after:
_local_function_declaration: $ => seq(
      repeat($._attribute_list),
      choice(
        prec(2, seq(
          alias('async', $.modifier),
          repeat($.modifier),
          field('type', $.type),
          field('name', $.identifier),
          field('type_parameters', optional($.type_parameter_list)),
          field('parameters', $.parameter_list),
        )),
        seq(
          repeat($.modifier),
          field('type', $.type),
          field('name', $.identifier),
          field('type_parameters', optional($.type_parameter_list)),
          field('parameters', $.parameter_list),
        ),
      ),
    ),

compilation_unit: $ => seq(
      optional($.shebang_directive),
      repeat($.file_based_app_directive),
      repeat($._top_level_item),
    ),

    file_based_app_directive: $ => seq(
      $._file_based_app_start,
      field('name', alias(token.immediate(/[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*/), $.identifier)),
      optional(seq(
        token.immediate(/[ \t]+/),
        field('argument', alias(token.immediate(/[^\r\n]+/), $.preproc_arg)),
      )),
    ),

operations.location: scan prefix before other handlers; skip-only fallthrough

operations.after:
choice(
          seq('defer', $.namespace_import, $._from_clause),
          seq(
            optional(choice('type', 'typeof')),
            choice(
              seq($.import_clause, $._from_clause),
              $.import_require_clause,
              field('source', $.string),
            ),
          ),
        ),

patches.limitations: 기존 default named defer는 legacy branch; defer namespace 전용 구문과 malformed named import를 판정

    inline_array_type: ($) => seq("[", field("size", choice(seq(optional("-"), $.integer_literal), $.simple_identifier)), "of", field("element", $._type), "]"),
